[P2] Address the untested default-selection branch

Rule 4, **Every branch has a test that fails without it**, is not satisfied here. Every added lifecycle test supplies a custom no-retry strategy through `session_config`; none invokes this function with `retry_strategy=None`. Removing the default fallback therefore leaves those tests unchanged, allowing the retry behavior used by callers who omit this option to regress undetected. Please return to the design phase under Rule 8, step 6, and establish the required behavioral coverage for both retry-selection paths.
